articles.title: Switching off cellular recycling gene increases yields of hard-to-make drug target proteins
articles.summary: With an unusual genetic modification that disabled cells' recycling systems, researchers found a way to make cells produce significantly larger amounts of the proteins used to discover and develop new medicines.
